fields.acceptance: A Go test finds the process, and with REX_BLOCK set the window and block, in the journal of a started run and of a resumed one, and a reader reports a fixture's unfinished journal as live and interrupted when its pid is not running, as live and running when it is the test's own process, and a finished journal as not live.
fields.statement: A run journals its process (host and pid) and, when it runs in Rex, its Rex window and block, when it starts and each time it is resumed, so a reader tells which of the live runs (unfinished journals, as run-one-live counts them) are running and which are interrupted (an unfinished journal whose process is gone), and where each run's tab is.
daemon-status depends on daemon-picks and daemon-run-tabs, so its check reads the state of a daemon that has picked and started a run. The check stays as written.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's option, picked by the owner: "Add the needs (Recommended)" (daemon-status needs daemon-picks and daemon-run-tabs; inbox-notify needs inbox-list; the checks stay as strong as written)

fields.statement: A run started in Rex journals its Rex window and block with its process, when it starts and each time it is resumed, so the inbox can focus a run's tab while it is open and say it is gone once it is closed.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's option, picked by the owner: "Journal the run's tab (Recommended)" (when a run starts in Rex, its journal records its window and block, alongside run-process-record's host and pid, so inbox-open focuses that tab when it's still open, and otherwise says it's gone)
